key.name: enabled-effects
key.description: List of animated pattern IDs active on the desktop wallpaper.

key.name: pattern-tuning
key.description: For each pattern id, any of "brightness", "speed" and "density" (the Amount setting), as multipliers of the pattern's design. Missing entries are 1.

key.name: span-monitors
key.description: Draw the patterns, and a gradient base, as one picture across every monitor instead of one per monitor.

key.name: saved-scenes
key.description: Scenes saved from the preferences: each a "name" and the values of the keys a scene covers.

key.name: weather
key.description: Let the weather where the user is choose the patterns, and the time of day the background, instead of enabled-effects, pattern-tuning and the background keys. Those keep the user's own look for when this is turned off.

key.name: weather-auto-location
key.description: Ask Location Services where the user is, while they are turned on. Otherwise, or when they are off, weather-place is used.

key.name: weather-place
key.description: A place chosen in the preferences: its name, latitude and longitude in degrees. An empty name is none.

key.name: weather-background
key.description: While following the weather, draw the patterns over a sky for the time of day and the weather, instead of the background chosen on the Background page.

key.name: weather-status
key.description: Written by the extension while following the weather: the place, the last report and when it came, for the preferences to show and for the next start to pick up. Cleared when weather is turned off.

key.name: background-mode
key.description: Base layer underneath patterns: 'desktop' (the system wallpaper), 'accent' (a gradient in GNOME's accent colour), 'color' (a palette gradient), or 'image' (a custom picture).

key.name: color-palette
key.description: Color scheme used when background-mode is 'color'.

key.name: custom-image
key.description: Path to custom wallpaper image used when background-mode is 'image'.

key.name: target-fps
key.description: How often the patterns are redrawn, in step with each display's own refresh: 0 is every frame it shows, a negative number every Nth frame (-2 every other one), and a positive number the nearest whole share of the display's rate to that many frames a second.

key.name: speed
key.description: Pace multiplier for all animations (0.25 to 3.0).

key.name: opacity
key.description: Global opacity of the animated patterns (0.1 to 1.0).

key.name: pause-when-covered
key.summary: Pause while windows cover the desktop
key.description: Stops drawing on a monitor while a fullscreen window, or maximized and tiled windows between them, hide its desktop.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Stops the animation while the device is running on battery.
